lines.text: There were little lights by the wall. Blue ones.
One of them stuck its tongue out at me. And I lost my mitten.
I'm not allowed past the bridge. I'm only looking.
And I still can't find my mitten. It's by the orchard fence somewhere. I looked. Not very hard.
I believe this is yours. It was keeping a fence post warm.
My mitten! You found it! Here, you can have my candy. I've got two.
I found a button by the wall. It's old. You can have it, because you found my mitten. That's fair.
My hand's warm now. The other one's still cold, though.
I'm in the front row! You can stand behind me if you're quiet.
I've only got the one mitten, though. It's out by the orchard fence, in the cold, all by itself.
